uin: A parent asks about Section 12(1)(c) of RTE Act for free private school admission.

prompts.english: What are the eligibility criteria and reservation rules under Section 12(1)(c) of the Right to Education (RTE) Act for private schools?
prompts.hindi: निजी स्कूलों के लिए शिक्षा का अधिकार (RTE) अधिनियम की धारा 12(1)(c) के तहत पात्रता मानदंड और आरक्षण नियम क्या हैं?
prompts.code_switch: Private schools ke liye RTE Act ke Section 12(1)(c) ke under eligibility criteria aur reservation rules kya hain?

primary_sources.name: Ministry of Education RTE Act 2009 Regulations

critical_facts.text: Mandatory 25% reservation of entry-level seats (Pre-primary or Class 1) for disadvantaged and weaker sections.
Education is completely free (no tuition, admission, or capitation fees).
State government reimburses private schools based on per-child expenditure.

important_facts.text: Neighborhood quota applies (typically within 1 km to 3 km radius).
Parents apply via state RTE online portal with income and domicile certificates.

optional_facts.text: Official application forms available online and offline.

safety_constraints: Must emphasize official government portal verification.
prohibited_claims: Claiming false upfront fees or unauthorized third-party middleman application processes.
